fairness.compute_not_equal: Training amortized offline; MCTS uses online simulator calls. Runtime/model call costs reported; algorithms do not receive equal compute.
fairness.trajectory_random_draw_alignment: Identical seeded environmental demand noise stream per scenario, independent of policy; verified identical realized demand paths across policies for every held-out seed.

limitations: Held-out seeds are independent synthetic draws in the authored model family; evaluator-only fixed world parameters differ slightly from the fitted training/planning model. This is limited model misspecification, not observed-company or broad out-of-distribution validation.
Normal-approximation confidence intervals over paired synthetic seed differences are descriptive and not calibrated business guarantees.
Coarse tabular public-state aggregation and approximate MCTS demand belief can fail. Heuristic may win.
No globally optimal oracle for the seven-day 12-action partially observed dynamics is claimed; the separate existing bounded sequential enumeration remains available for its tiny tractable scope.
